title: Pressure injury stages

findings.where: Clinical claim 7; pressure-injury.jsx facts[6] and Frame.desc used in images 1 and 9
findings.title: DTPI etiology incorrectly says pressure OR shear
findings.problem: "Resulting from pressure or shear" makes shear alone sufficient to classify an injury as DTPI. NPIAP distinguishes pressure injuries from traumatic injuries: pressure is required, alone or combined with shear. Its DTPI definition specifically describes pressure and shear forces at the bone-muscle interface.
findings.fix: Replace the causal wording with the NPIAP formulation: "results from intense and/or prolonged pressure and shear forces at the bone-muscle interface." Correct both the facts entry and the SVG description.

assessment: Revise before publication: the DTPI definition incorrectly allows shear alone as its cause.
